data.name: Verner
data.long_meaning: The name Verner is of Latin origin and means 'brave, strong'. In the Christian tradition, this name is often associated with the saint Verner of Cologne, who is said to have been a brave and steadfast bishop. The name is also found in the Bible in the form of Vernerus, a Roman soldier who converted to Christianity and was later martyred for his faith.
